We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we need the compound identity? Not provided. Perhaps the system has a sample at hand (some unknown). We need to measure IR to detect C=O. Use ir_spectra tool. That returns IR peaks. Look for strong absorption around 1700 cm-1 typical carbonyl. Count number of distinct carbonyl peaks. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That may be more precise. Use carbon NMR to count signals in carbonyl region.

We should first get carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
